steps.note: Open the Single Stage event creation screen.
Enable the required tenant configuration that prevents vendor additions during event creation.
Disable mandatory T&Cs so the case uses the requested tenant setup.
Select RFQ and the radio option for partially awarding the event to multiple vendors; saving this configuration checks that the window closes.
Apply the available RFQ pricing template.
Add the specified product with quantity 10.
Complete the pricing sheet required for publishing.
Add the product's available vendor audience before publishing.
Publish the configured RFQ so it can appear in the events list.
Confirm the event was created as a real published project.
Return to the events list to verify the plan's own event is listed.
Confirm the events list rendered without an error.
Assert that the newly published event appears in the list.
